slots.title: OKX-ICE co-chair Andrew Cuomo calls corporate objections a ‘natural response’ to tokenized stock plans
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: The former NY governor, who co-chairs the joint venture between the crypto exchange and Intercontinental Exchange, said companies were expected to take a wait-and-see approach.

slots.title: The Coinbase allegations expose Bitcoin's corporate governance gap
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Corporate adoption of bitcoin will stall as long as companies can't show who controls the money, who approves its movement, or whether it's still there, argues Onramp CEO Michael Tanguma.

slots.title: OpenAI acquires startup Orchestra Bio⁠ to beef up its biotech business
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: OpenAI says it's adding Orchestra's team and technology to work on Rosalind, its AI model for life sciences research, and to its related Rosalind Workbench tool, a harness that aims to help researchers plan experiments and analyze results.

slots.title: Google is bringing a more personal version of its Gemini AI assistant to your car
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: Google is bringing Gemini's Personal Intelligence feature to cars, allowing its AI assistant to draw on information from Gmail, Calendar, Maps, YouTube, and other Google services to deliver more personalized responses while driving.
